title: Knowledge bases
subtitle: Documents your API keys can search, so models answer with your own content. Each knowledge base belongs to one company, or to one project in it.
empty: Create a knowledge base and upload documents. Each file is split into passages and indexed, then the company's API keys can search it with file_search.
readOnly: You can view knowledge bases and their files. Changing them needs the tenancy:manage permission.
